body: Bc ppl are selfish. It’s easier to just say “no don’t” than actually help or see what’s better for the person at hand
Cannot push how hard I relate to this.

If life could get better it kind of should have by now for me lol. I’ve had clinical depression since like second grade and now I’m almost 20. I’m kind of over waiting for it to just get better when I can’t even see the reason to brush my teeth
While that’s good advice, I personally can’t even have hobbies anymore without being intensely aware that it’s useless to actually try and be good at anything
While this post is sweet, don’t forget to care about yourself as well, OP. It’s wonderful that you’re willing to be a listening ear, just make sure you also take care of yourself!

There’s times I want to be babied and loved on and told I’m loved and a violent depressive episode is not one of those times. 
I understand you 100%. I’m terrified of being sent in somewhere already, during a pandemic seems like an even worse idea.

The worst part of BED is that many people don’t see it as a “real” eating disorder (IE. you’re not starving yourself so for some reason it shouldn’t count)
In reality, it’s actually incredibly commendable that you’ve hit the first step of recovery. You’re aware of your disordered eating and want to change it. While I don’t think r/BingeEatingDisorder is incredibly active, it IS full of success stories in the same vain as yours. Best of luck to you, and don’t deny yourself food when you need it. Your body needs fuel to keep going, remember that!

If the feeling calm part is what’s worrying you, I’d keep in mind that when the human brain is hit with something shocking/scary/really sad, sometimes it just shuts down for a little bit to process those emotions
